ingestion: manual synthetic source-bound admission in listed arrival order

events.text: On 2031-04-01, I chose HarborSketch because I can edit drafts offline. I have not chosen another app.
On 2031-04-01, I tested HarborSketch without a connection and could edit a draft offline.
On 2031-04-03, I reported that HarborSketch could not edit drafts offline after one interrupted test.
On 2031-04-04, I repeated the test: my device caused the interruption. HarborSketch still edits drafts offline. My April 3 report was mistaken; my app choice has not changed.
2031年5月1日，我選擇青嵐繪圖板，因為它可以離線匯出PNG。我還沒有改選其他產品。
2031年5月1日，我在沒有網路的情況下，成功用青嵐繪圖板匯出PNG。
2031年5月4日，更新後我再次測試：青嵐繪圖板現在不能離線匯出PNG；我尚未決定換產品。
On 2031-06-01, I chose CedarBoard because it keeps drafts locally and encrypts exported files. I have not changed my choice.
On 2031-06-01, I tested CedarBoard: drafts remained editable locally without a connection.
On 2031-06-03, I reported that CedarBoard had lost local draft editing after an interrupted test.
On 2031-06-04, I repeated the local-draft test. The June 3 report was mistaken: local draft editing still works.
On 2031-06-04, I verified that CedarBoard no longer encrypts exported files. I have not selected a replacement board.
On 2031-06-01, I tested CedarBoard: exported files were encrypted. This is my original June 1 observation, imported on June 5 after the June 4 update.
